integrity: The proof combines the source's exact dual distance and 3-design theorem with a two-way linear recovery/dual-check factorization. The derived-design counts and matching bound are exact consequences. A standalone finite-field verifier reconstructs the \(q=9\) source code and exhaustively checks all four-coordinate dependencies and every derived repair design.
scientific_limitations: The complete classification is for minimum-cardinality recovery sets. The disjoint-repair formula is a guaranteed lower bound from greedy matching and is not asserted to be the exact matching number of every derived design.
title: Minimum repair triples form exact 2-designs in the new 3-design LRC family
